title: [Master]  Basal rate on AAPSClient doesn't update occasionally (V3+WS)
body:
AAPS / AAPSClient 3.2.0.1 NSClientV3+WS on both
NS 15.0.2

I've seen a few times today that openAPS-log says that temp 0 basalrate should be set, but it doesn't get updated in AAPSClient, I've checked AAPS to verify that a 0-basalrate has been set, and every time I've checked it has sucessfully set 0 basal but not getting updated in AAPSClient.

Hi @MilosKozak  :) Sorry for late response. We got 3 phones following AAPS with NsclientV3+WS. All phones got standard android settings in regards of date and time. I can't really tell any time difference, if so it's milliseconds. I tried rebooting AAPS and my own phone also. 

What's odd is that it doesn't happen every time, and so far I've only noticed it when a temp 0 basal is issued or prolonged. I'm pretty sure it happens daily more than once but not so many times that this is something critical. It just make me worry some times that basal is still running when BG is falling alltho OAPS-log seem to suggest a temp 0 basal is set.

I can't remember this happening in 3.1.0.3 when using NSClient. I've not tested with NSClientV1 since I'm unable to change the 3rd AAPSClient NSClient-version as it at school at all times. (Is it a problem if an idle AAPSCLient is on V3 for a few hours while others are on V1?)

Screenshot of date/time settings:
![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/114103483/611c3c08-8963-4ffd-833d-7834add1b28c)

Since its abit sporadic and some times 0 basal updates two or three minutes after recieved update from OAPS also, im not sure if there is necessary to do anything about this if code or logs seem ok. I can monitor abit more the coming days and see if i can provide a good example, else ill close issue.

Issue persists and happens a few times a day, it's not only temp 0 basal it's all basal updates. I'll bring another example if it can help improving this. If it matters we are using Omnipod Dash and xDrip / G6.

Notice at 20:19 OpenAPS-log suggest a zero TBR should be set 4 min ago. Basal is still showing 0,3 in AAPSClient. It was a TBR 0 set for 30min before this. So when AAPS wants to set 120min TBR 0 it first reset to default basal rate 0,3 then set 120min TBR 0. AAPSClient updates the reset of basal rate, but not the new 120min TBR 0. 

Nothing in NSCv3 log about temp basal update. Then at 20:20 temp basal is updated (back in time) for the temp basal being set by AAPS at 20:15.
